sections.markdown:
## F — Research index and VERIFY list: Sharing roads with pedestrians, cyclists, motorcycles and large vehicles
Knowledge index: part C contains 60 original fact blocks across 1 chunks; part C2 contains 30 continuation fact blocks across 1 chunks, all from this section’s mapped physical pages.
Authority and exam facts are located in A.01; audience in B.01; accuracy limits in D.01; demand and competitor gaps in E.01 and E2.01.
VERIFY list:
Accepted inventory: 60 C facts; 30 C2 facts; 10 typed debts; ids DE-SHARING-COUNT, DE-SHARING-PASS, DE-SHARING-TIME, DE-SHARING-CADENCE, DE-SHARING-COVER, DE-SHARING-BUS-SCOPE, DE-SHARING-MOTO-BOUNDARY, DE-SHARING-VISUAL, DE-SHARING-MARKET, DE-SHARING-TEARDOWN.
- DE-SHARING-COUNT: The handbook does not state the knowledge-test question count; obtain an applicable official issuer statement before displaying a count.
- DE-SHARING-PASS: The handbook does not state a knowledge-test passing percentage or passing score; obtain an applicable official issuer statement before displaying a threshold.
- DE-SHARING-TIME: The handbook does not state a knowledge-test time limit; do not substitute the road-exam duration.
- DE-SHARING-CADENCE: The snapshot is dated July on the front cover; the frequency of handbook revision was not independently verified.
- DE-SHARING-COVER: The extracted cover text carries the edition but not the graphical title or issuer; the issuer is established separately by frontmatter and the official linking page.
- DE-SHARING-BUS-SCOPE: The pedestrian subsection adds a divided-highway qualifier to the school-bus exception, while the earlier detailed bus section states the lane-count exception without that word. Issuer clarification is needed before teaching a unified exception.
- DE-SHARING-MOTO-BOUNDARY: The motorcycle following-distance passage specifies gaps below and above forty miles per hour but leaves the exact boundary unstated. Do not silently replace either comparison with an inclusive one.
- DE-SHARING-VISUAL: Bike-box, shared-lane and truck No-Zone diagrams have not been visually validated. Image-based identification or position questions need source-image review.
- DE-SHARING-MARKET: market pack requires sourced recon.
- DE-SHARING-TEARDOWN: competitive teardown requires sourced inspection.
Dynamic isolation: Contact details and mutable service/provider information remain outside stable facts; monetary and numerical rules are stated only as source-edition facts.

corpus_stability.reason: Working assessment from a single dated official handbook snapshot; actual revision frequency remains unverified debt in part A.
